steps.code:
# Parse all notes to extract habit data
import re

# Get habit names from the first note
first_content = all_note_contents[0]['content']
habit_lines = [line.strip() for line in first_content.split('\n') if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#')]
habit_names = [line.split(':')[0].strip() for line in habit_lines]
print("Habit names:", habit_names)

# Parse all notes
rows = []
for note_detail in all_note_contents:
    # Extract date from title
    title = note_detail['title']
    date_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not date_match:
        continue
    date = date_match.group(1)
    
    # Parse content
    content = note_detail['content']
    values = {}
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            values[habit.strip()] = value.strip()
    
    # Build row
    row = [date] + [values.get(habit, 'no') for habit in habit_names]
    rows.append(row)

# Sort by date ascending
rows.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

print(f"Parsed {len(rows)} rows")
print("First row:", rows[0])
print("Last row:", rows[-1])
